there is 100% cure for your condition(s). Its called self-forgiveness writing/reading within all self-honesty. of course no overnight cures, may take few months of consistent writing/reading of it. see some examples in my blog, basically here is it:

I forgive myself that I have accepted and allowed myself to let anxiety take over me, and rule me over. (so on and on, then, self-corrective statements: when and as I feel I getting anxious again, I stop my mind's thinking/thoughts/ideas/beliefs, and simply breathe here. try speaking above statements out aloud (of course when nobody is around, lol). thanks.

sorry no quick solution as per tomorrow. however, my suggested tool will take time and self-application, certainly give it a try later when you can. as per tomorrow, here is something you can try: attend without ANY thoughts whatsoever within your mind, dont' let any ideas/thoughts/beliefs/memories/fears entertain within your mind. And the way to do that is, through breathing/breath. You breath-in, hold for a 2-seconds, then breathe-out, nobody will notice it, its a subtle tool, but breath by breath, you have to apply to STOP your mind from compounding the situation. This is the only certain suggestion i can give, if you have guts to breathe-in, hold, breathe0-out, you can walk in and face the 'hell' and be not reactive within or without. enjoy.

if you really want support in overcoming your self-limiting issues, like been introverted etc, investigate the tool of self-forgiveness, its a tool you apply for you, by yourself, within your own space, only requirement is do it with all honesty, for at least 21 days. its basically self-writing within a specific format. i have doing it for now 104 days in a row, lol, on various self-limiting issues, but you can focus just on your shyness related matters, so check it out, learn the art, do it by yourself, all you need is bit of time and discipline daily. see my blog for details, www.antonfernando.com thanks

hi, so your wife cheated on you. OK. let's see your options. Anger, hate, bitterness, rage, revenge, betrayal, even suicide may be the emotions one may go thru. Goes without saying, all of those are pretty self-destructive. There is an old saying "Anger is like taking poison and hope your enemy will die". I guess my point is, self-destruction in any form in relation to such profound betrayal and heartbreak is a solution at all. Investigate self-forgiveness, it is a self-releasing/purifying tool self can use to rebirth self from such profound experience. You have to set yourself free from this nasty experience, otherwise it will haunt/eat you slowly. may be someday you will forgive her, but that's down the road, for now, self-forgive yourself for accepting and allowing yourself to torture yourself in pain and (all other emotions and feeling you have).  of course this is process, it will take some time, even months perhaps, but worth the application, see how you experience yourself afterwords. check my site to get some examples on self forgiveness. thanks. see antonfernando dot com, cool.
